result.summary: Several visual/content bugs: a raw localization key shown as a section title, truncated restaurant names, and a partially cut-off category chip. These make the feed look broken and unfinished.

issues.description: Section heading displays the raw i18n/localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the proper localized string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so missing translations never render the key.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, use a shorter display name, or ensure the card width and typography accommodate full names without ellipsis clipping mid-word awkwardly.

issues.description: The last category filter chip ('Healthy') is partially clipped at the right edge, suggesting incomplete horizontal scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent end padding/inset to the horizontal chip list so the last item is fully visible or clearly scrollable.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza) is heavily cropped by the bottom nav, so the offer/content feels incomplete on first view.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate bottom content padding above the tab bar so cards aren’t awkwardly cut off when the feed loads.
